verdict.rationale: HumanLayer hosts the cloud control plane: you can control tasks from app.humanlayer.com, and automation sessions are "Cloud-visible," so you don't run your own coordination backend. However, the agents themselves run on compute you supply. The docs describe bring-your-own compute, your workstation, or remote daemons on a cloud VM or private machine you must install, authenticate and launch. Missing for 10: HumanLayer-managed agent execution or compute, a hosted runtime that needs no self-operated hosts, and independent corroboration of the cloud offering.
